meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: 用 Python 的 Cirq 框架构建、模拟和优化量子电路,可提交到 Google 量子处理器及 IonQ 等后端运行,也能做噪声建模与量子表征实验。
howto.when: 当你要求构建、模拟或优化 NISQ 量子电路,瞄准 Google 量子硬件,或设计噪声感知电路与表征实验时接管。

say.text: 用 Cirq 写一个两比特贝尔态电路,在模拟器上跑 1000 次
say.note: 返回电路图和测量直方图

say.text: 给这个电路加上去极化噪声,比较不同噪声水平的结果
say.note: 改用密度矩阵模拟器做噪声对比

say.text: 把这条电路提交到 Google 的 Weber 处理器上运行
say.note: 需要已批准的 GCP 项目权限

howto.what_en: Builds, simulates and optimizes quantum circuits in Python with Cirq, and can submit them to Google Quantum AI chips plus IonQ and other backends, including noise modeling and characterization experiments.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to build, simulate or optimize NISQ circuits, target Google quantum hardware, or design noise-aware circuits and characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Write a two-qubit Bell state in Cirq and run it on the simulator 1000 times
say_en.note: Returns the circuit diagram and a measurement histogram

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare results at different noise levels
say_en.note: Switches to the density matrix simulator for the noise study

say_en.text: Submit this circuit to Google's Weber processor
